title: AttachmentReference
description: An uploaded attachment referenced when creating or editing a message.

id.description: Attachment ID from POST /channels/{id}/attachments, or an index for existing ones.

description.description: Alt text shown to screen readers and as the image tooltip.

flags.description: AttachmentFlags bit set; IS_SPOILER (8) marks the file as a spoiler. A SPOILER_ filename prefix sets it too.
